verdict: Leads cost less this period, but volume is down and pipeline visibility is limited.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 122 leads at $11.90 cost per lead — a 26% efficiency improvement week over week. However, that gain is driven by a 33% reduction in spend, not by the ads working harder, so the lower cost per lead comes alongside fewer leads overall. In the most recent three days of the window, daily spend and lead volume both dropped sharply, which is the immediate concern heading into next week. Two back-end setup tasks — closing an attribution gap and completing a contact sync — are overdue, which means we currently can't confirm how many of those leads are moving toward appointments; both items are being completed now so the August scoreboard is trustworthy before month-end.
